Hi everyone,

It's time to pick our Airbnb for Monday, Aug 17 – Friday, Aug 21 (4 nights). Here are three options. Please reply with your preference.

Option 1: Lakeside Cabin ($300/person)
3 bedrooms, 2 baths, on the lake, 15 min to town. Hot tub, kayaks, fire pit. Rated 4.92, free cancellation until 7 days before.

Option 2: Downtown Loft ($220/person)
2 bedrooms + sofa bed, 1.5 baths, walkable to restaurants and bars. Cheapest, but street parking only and can be noisy. Rated 4.85.

Option 3: Cozy Farmhouse ($400/person)
4 bedrooms (everyone gets their own room), 2 baths, 25 min to town. Big kitchen, fire pit, pool table. Rated 4.95, but non-refundable.

Prices include all fees. Check-in is 4 PM and check-out is 12 PM for all three. Let me know if you have any special need or must-haves, and I'll book as soon as we decide.

Thanks,
Alice
